sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule dark chestnut brown; postclypeus slightly paler; antennae, labrum and legs golden yellow; thorax and abdominal tergites dark yellow-brown. Head and body rather densely hairy. Body length ♀ 24.2 mm, dealate male 4.4 mm. Head capsule subquadrate (0.80—0.83 mm to the mandible bases, 0.83—0.85 mm wide including the compound eyes); V suture present, shallow. Fontanelle plate small, circular. Compound eyes nearly circular (diameter 0.24—0.25 × 0.23 mm). Ocelli oval (major diameter 0.10—0.13 mm, minor diameter 0.07—0.08 mm), separated from the compound eye by less than their minor diameter. Antennae 14-segmented; segment 3 the shortest. Postclypeus slightly inflated, about 1/2 as long as wide; anterior margin straight, posterior margin rounded. Pronotum nearly trapezoidal; anterior margin slightly convex, without a notch; posterior margin straight, slightly concave in the middle; length 0.40—0.41 mm, width 0.65—0.70 mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule yellow-brown to dark brown; antennae and labrum pale brown; mandibles dark brown with a reddish tinge; body pale yellow. Head sparsely hairy, body densely hairy. Body length 4.1—5.0 mm. Head capsule subrectangular (1.37—1.68 mm to the mandible bases, maximum width 0.85—0.98 mm); sides nearly parallel and straight, or slightly narrowing posteriorly; width more than half the length (width/length index 0.54—0.64). Fontanelle minute, in the anterior 1/3 of the head. Antennae 13-segmented; segment 3 the smallest. Labrum pentagonal; anterior margin convex, with a rounded projection in the middle. Mandibles stout, coarsely serrate, with 1 slightly larger serration behind the middle; length generally less than 2/3 of the head length (length 0.87—0.92 mm, left mandible length/head length index 0.53—0.67). Postmentum rod-shaped (length 0.77—1.05 mm, maximum width 0.30—0.32 mm, waist width 0.17—0.20 mm); the waist behind the middle. Pronotum saddle-shaped (length 0.27—0.32 mm, width 0.55—0.60 mm); anterior margin with a distinct median notch, posterior margin slightly concave in the middle.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule pale yellow; body pale yellow. Head and body rather densely hairy. Body length 3.5—4.0 mm. Head capsule subquadrate (0.90 mm to the mandible bases, maximum width 0.90 mm). Fontanelle indistinct. Antennae 13-segmented. Postclypeus hairy; about half as long as wide; anterior margin straight, posterior margin rounded. Pronotum saddle-shaped (length 0.17—0.30 mm, width 0.47—0.55 mm).

note: Adapted from the entry in Chhotani (1997), original in English; soldier, worker and alate are all available; synonymy lists, figure numbers and distribution records are not translated. In the original the alate body length is OCR'd as ♀ 24.2 and dealate male 4.4 mm; the figures look incomplete and are reproduced here as they stand.
